eval through eval7: precedence, left associativity, syntax checks on skipped branches; evaluate guards on numeric and regex operations. null/looks_like_integer: minus/zeros versus plus. mpz_tdiv_q/r: signed division/remainder. docolon: BRE flags, anchored matching, first capture, newline policy. mbs helpers: locale-dependent logical characters, not graphemes. Source SHA matches local release-archive member.

Downloaded into a bounded hash stream only; matches existing dev-only archive. This leaf did not independently rerun detached-signature verification or rebuild the executable. Binary hash, version, exact path and runtime receipts are separately pinned.

BRE syntax and locale cautions only; grep file/binary behavior is NOT imported into expr. Invalid encoding and locale-sensitive ranges are not universal guarantees. expr-specific behavior comes from pinned expr source/receipts.

Official Apple source browsed only as dialect context. Moving main is NOT authenticated as source for the installed /bin/expr. The installed binary has no supported --version interface; its literal --version result, binary hash, macOS build and Darwin kernel define the measured separate profile.
